# Server test classes CI's server job leaves out (build-and-test.yml, "Test server"). One per line:
#   UT_Name  # why it can't run in CI (#issue)
# Every class here reads the installed game files (navmeshes, the played or release database, captured route logs), which
# are never in Git, and is also [Explicit], so it runs only when named, on the owner's PC. Issue #619 tracks the list: an
# entry comes off when its class no longer needs installed files. A synthetic test never goes here; fix it, or quarantine
# it as UT_Name.Method with its own issue (docs/CI.md, "Excluded tests"). source/tools/ci_test_results.py checks the format.
UT_AllFrontierKeepRoutes  # installed frontier route simulation; read only: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_AnimistInstalledCatalog  # read-only installed spell/template catalog check: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_AuditHotspotProbe  # read-only installed-navmesh hotspot probe: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_AuditedDungeonInstalledMesh  # read-only installed dungeon coverage audit: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_CrauchonResponseRoutes  # read-only installed Crauchon response incident: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_CurrentDungeonGoalRoutes  # read-only installed native routes for every current ordinary dungeon goal: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_DragonLairProbe  # reads installed navigation meshes only: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_DungeonProofGenerator  # generates navigation proofs from the installed navmesh: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_ExchangePlacementNavigation  # reads the installed capital navmeshes only: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_ExpeditionHubFailures  # read-only reproduction of captured expedition routes: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_ExpeditionInteriorCapacity  # read-only installed epic interior formation check: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_FloorAtPointsProbe  # navmesh floor probe tool: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_IarnwoodCornerProbe  # navmesh corner probe tool: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_InstalledClassicMeleeAudit  # read-only installed Classic style and poison catalog audit: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_InstalledKeepRoutes  # read-only installed keep navigation: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_InstalledPorterWaiting  # read-only installed teleporter mesh check: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_KeepDoorNavmeshProbe  # read-only installed-navmesh keep probe: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_LongRunNavigationProbe  # requires OFFLINE_DAOC_NAV_ROOT; reads local meshes only: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_NavGapProbe  # navmesh gap analysis tool: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_PathProbe  # navmesh path probe tool: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_PlayerTravelInstalledMesh  # read-only installed navmesh and database probes; never starts the server: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_PortalExitProbe  # installed navmesh read-only: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_RealmEventAuditReadOnly  # read-only captured route diagnostics, never edits meshes or game state: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_RealmEventNavigation  # read-only installed raid entrance and interior route proofs: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_RealmExchangeRelocation  # read-only installed-navmesh realm exchange proof: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_RealmRepairNavigation  # installed navigation read-only repair probes: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_RecentHibDungeonSeams  # read-only installed Hibernian dungeon exterior route proof: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
UT_September11HotspotProbe  # read-only installed hotspot navigation checks: needs the installed game files, [Explicit] (#619)
